nom: Patchology Serve Chilled Cool Crush Extra-Depuffing Hydrogel Eye Patches

extraits.texte: Used once so far, didn't really see a huge difference. Will try again.

I've been using Patchology for a few years now, and this is by far my all-time favorite. The patches stay in place without any slipping, and my skin feels incredibly refreshed after removing them. I highly recommend giving them a try!
I love the Serve Chilled masks, especially On Ice. The new Cool Crush eye masks work well out of the fridge to depuff under-eyes. They're hydrating too. I use Cool Crush pre makeup in the morning.
These are my favorite Patchology eye gels. They never fail to relieve the puffiness in my eyes in the morning. Try em out. You won't regret it!

reserve: Reviewers do not state their skin type or specific skin concerns, so segmentation by skin type and by concern cannot be produced from this review set.
